# Support Policy and Guidelines

Generally, the best place to start will be the
[Discussions](https://github.com/huntbase-io/steampipe-plugin-criminalip/discussions/new/choose)
forum or through the Steampipe Slack community. If you can't find what you're
looking for there, consider raising an
[issue](https://github.com/huntbase-io/steampipe-plugin-criminalip/issues/new/choose)

## Criminal IP API Version

We support the Criminal IP REST API (`https://api.criminalip.io`) v1, v2 and v3 endpoints as of October 2026.

## Steampipe Version

We support this plugin in Steampipe >= 2.0 (tested with v2.4.8).

## Golang Version

We support this plugin with Golang >= v1.26 (the minimum for steampipe-plugin-sdk v5.14), as required by Steampipe's
[Plugin Development Guidelines](https://steampipe.io/docs/develop/plugin-release-checklist)
